description: This file defines a React functional component 'MaskConfig' that provides a user interface for configuring a 'Mask' object in a chat application. It includes controls for avatar selection, name editing, context hiding, sharing, synchronization with global settings, and other model configurations.

methods.name: MaskConfig
methods.description: React functional component that renders configuration options for a 'Mask' object, including avatar, name, context visibility, sharing, sync with global config, and model settings.

methods.name: updateConfig
methods.description: Helper function to update the model configuration within the mask, respecting the readonly state.

methods.name: copyMaskLink
methods.description: Function to copy a link to the clipboard that references the current mask.
